name: calabim_settler
description: a Calabim Settler, a pale black-haired vampire colonist with a red eye: a red hood, a black-and-red cloak over a red tunic with a brown belt and pouches, black trousers and black boots, a huge brown backpack on his back with a rolled red bedroll across the top and an iron lantern hanging at its side, his RIGHT hand an empty fist gripping the pack strap at his chest, and a long gnarled wooden walking staff in his LEFT hand
hands: the walking staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty fist (at rest it grips the backpack strap at his chest)

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the walking staff is lifted up over the head with its gnarled top end pointing up and back, the big backpack on his back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the walking staff cocked behind the head with its top end hanging down behind the shoulders and the backpack, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the walking staff is level, its gnarled top end pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the walking staff's top end cracking down-right like a club, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the walking staff carries on down until its top end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the hood and the lantern swinging back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the walking staff lifts back toward its upright resting angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left inside the red hood, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the walking staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out, the backpack pulling him back

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back under the weight of the backpack, staff arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops in the red hood, the walking staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the walking staff's top end resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging, the backpack still on his back
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left onto the backpack, the walking staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back on the backpack along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the red bedroll and the lantern beside his head; the walking staff lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the lantern rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back on the backpack, eyes closed, the walking staff on the ground beside him
